overview: The Medford School Committee approved the 2026-2027 meeting schedule, voted to opt out of the state's school choice program, and approved updates to its restraint and bullying prevention policies. The committee also discussed a newly discovered property deed restriction affecting the high school building project and passed a resolution to assess the district's Project Transition program.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, which included bills, payroll, budget transfers, meeting minutes, and student field trips.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Career Technical Education Showcase
items.summary: The Superintendent and Career Technical Education staff highlighted accomplishments of students in the electrical, biotechnology, and health assisting programs.

items.title: FY 2026-2027 School Choice Program Participation
items.summary: The committee voted to opt out of the Commonwealth's external school choice program for the upcoming school year to maintain instructional focus on local residents.

items.title: School Committee Meeting Schedule for 2026-2027
items.summary: The committee approved the 2026-2027 meeting schedule with an amendment to add a meeting on June 14th.

items.title: Medford Public Schools Handbooks Review
items.summary: The committee discussed updates to school handbooks, including new academic honesty policies and elementary recess guidelines, and voted to table the item until June 8th for revisions.

items.title: MPS Restraint Policy and Bullying Prevention Plan Updates
items.summary: The committee approved updated language for the district's bullying prevention plan and restraint policy to align with Department of Elementary and Secondary Education regulations.

items.title: Massachusetts School Building Authority Project Update
items.summary: The administration and project consultants reviewed feedback from the MSBA and discussed a 999-year DCR deed restriction on the property that affects current high school design options.

items.title: Resolution on Project Transition Program Assessment
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution directing the administration to conduct a comprehensive assessment of the Project Transition program for young adults with disabilities by December 2026.
